digo: Chiphala kanga; Mvundza jembe (Pakia App. III, shared with several shrubs)
other_mijikenda: Duruma: shares mvundza jembe (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: A guinea-fowl name nobody can fully explain, and a place in the peace-making rites of Digo homesteads.
teaser.sw: Jina la kanga ambalo hakuna anayeweza kulieleza kikamilifu, na nafasi katika mila za upatanishi za makazi ya Kidigo.

summary.en: *Chiphala kanga* is a forest shrub of the spurge family. Under its other name, *mvundza jembe*, it is one of several shrubs used in rites to settle disputes.
summary.sw: *Chiphala kanga* ni kichaka cha msituni cha familia ya mibono. Kwa jina lake jingine, *mvundza jembe*, ni mojawapo ya vichaka kadhaa vinavyotumika katika mila za kusuluhisha migogoro.

about.en: *Alchornea laxiflora* is a shrub or small tree of the forest understorey and margins. It has thin, toothed, oval leaves on long stalks, and its young leaves are often reddish. Male and female flowers are borne in slender spikes, and the fruits are small, hairy, two- or three-lobed capsules.
about.sw: *Alchornea laxiflora* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa sehemu ya chini na pembezoni mwa msitu. Kina majani membamba, yenye meno, ya umbo la yai juu ya vikonyo virefu, na majani yake machanga mara nyingi huwa na rangi nyekundu. Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota katika vishada virefu vyembamba, na matunda ni vifuko vidogo vyenye manyoya, vyenye ndewe mbili au tatu.

where.en: It grows in forest, forest edges and thicket in tropical Africa, including the East African coast.
where.sw: Huota msituni, pembezoni mwa misitu na vichaka vizito katika maeneo ya tropiki ya Afrika, ikiwemo pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.

culture.en: Pakia also records this shrub as *mvundza jembe*, 'hoe breaker'. That name covers several shrubs, including *Allophylus rubifolius*, *Acalypha neptunica* and *Mallotus oppositifolius*. Any of them can be used in the spiritual work of ending (*vundza*) quarrels and bringing peace. In the rites for settling domestic and community disputes, the hand hoe (*jembe*) is a symbolic object. Read literally, the name could also warn a farmer that the stumps of these shrubs can damage a hoe.
culture.sw: Pakia pia ameandika kichaka hiki kama *mvundza jembe*, 'mvunja jembe'. Jina hilo linajumuisha vichaka kadhaa, vikiwemo *Allophylus rubifolius*, *Acalypha neptunica* na *Mallotus oppositifolius*. Chochote kati yake kinaweza kutumika katika kazi ya kiroho ya kumaliza (*vundza*) ugomvi na kuleta amani. Katika mila za kusuluhisha migogoro ya nyumbani na ya jamii, jembe la mkono (*jembe*) ni kitu cha ishara. Likisomwa kwa maana yake halisi, jina hili linaweza pia kumwonya mkulima kwamba visiki vya vichaka hivi vinaweza kuharibu jembe.

names.en: *Chiphala kanga* refers to *kanga*, the guinea fowl, but Pakia says the meaning of *chiphala* is unknown. *Mvundza jembe* is shared with Duruma. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chiphala kanga* linarejelea *kanga*, ndege kanga, lakini Pakia anasema maana ya *chiphala* haijulikani. *Mvundza jembe* linashirikiwa na Kiduruma. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.

reason.en: Plant used to stir up disputes
